relation_to_prior_study: Separate new CPU inference cohort using frozen WSC/HANS cases; not an execution or replication of four Adaption aliases. Model IDs were chosen for accessible public three-way NLI classification before seeing these models on the cases.

inference.implementation: transformers AutoTokenizer and AutoModelForSequenceClassification, pretrained public model weights, local CPU only
inference.max_sequence_length: full input with truncation disabled, fail if exceeds model position limit
inference.prediction: argmax float32 logits, tie to lowest config index
inference.prompts_or_tools: none; model input is ordered premise and hypothesis only
inference.weights: exact model revisions and downloaded source file SHA256 receipt before inference
inference.failure_policy: no output imputation or candidate replacement; preserve partial output, fail full-candidate analysis if any of 224 tasks missing

scoring.wsc_imposed_paired: gold replacement predicted entailment AND non-gold predicted contradiction
scoring.wsc_repaired_paired: gold replacement predicted entailment AND non-gold predicted neutral or contradiction
scoring.selection: unique highest raw paired count among 35 selection passages separately for imposed/repaired; ties unresolved
scoring.confirmation: if both winners unique, compare their repaired paired accuracy on independent 37 WSC confirmation passages; report signed repaired-selected minus imposed-selected difference, including zero/negative
scoring.hans_external: if both winners unique, compare binary HANS80 accuracy; entailment vs contradiction/neutral
scoring.pairwise_orderings: all six candidate pairs, report strict sign reversals, ties separately
scoring.uncertainty: 10,000 source-family bootstrap draws for WSC; 10,000 template-cluster bootstrap draws for HANS; fixed winners in confirmation resamples
scoring.scope: Conditional, exploratory fixed-source estimates. No human-certified WSC NLI gold; prior source semantic review agent-generated. HANS pretraining exposure unknown. Selection raw-score abstraction does not implement full original advice significance/macro-F1 policy.

stopping: Run all four pinned models, all 224 tasks each; no early success stopping, reranking candidate set, changing inputs after output inspection, or retrying failed model under same receipt. Report incompletes and nulls.

evidence_levels.S1: Different unique selection winners under imposed and repaired rules
evidence_levels.S2: Positive repaired-selected minus imposed-selected accuracy on independent WSC confirmation
evidence_levels.S3: Positive corresponding difference on HANS80, with template-cluster descriptive interval separately reported. No GAMMAF-level claim without human validation and robust independent replication.
